title: Transition table bit list
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let a transition rule assign an action to each of $n+1$ states, each possibly blank Boolean input symbol, and each configuration of the $k$ work tape reads. The table bit list concatenates, in order, the bit lists encoding the actions for every such combination, with states and input symbols enumerated in the given order and work tape reads enumerated by the recursive list described above.
hypotheses_covered: A transition rule on $n+1$ states, possibly blank Boolean input symbols, and $k$ possibly blank Boolean work tape reads
caveat: The supplied snippet uses an action-to-bits encoding but does not include its definition, so the precise meaning of each action’s bit list cannot be stated from the provided ground truth.
